info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Ecommerce Cart Shippings-v2-spec
info.description: This API provides access to shipping options for items in an ecommerce cart. It allows users to retrieve available shipping methods and their associated costs based on the contents of the shopping cart. Typically utilized by online retailers and ecommerce platforms, this API facilitates a seamless checkout experience by offering customers various shipping choices. Developers can integrate this endpoint to enhance their application’s cart management features and improve user satisfaction during the purchasing process.

get.summary: Retrieve shipping information for the cart.
get.description: This endpoint fetches the current shipping details associated with the user's shopping cart, including available shipping options and costs.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the shipping details for the cart. It should contain all necessary information required to process the shipping details accurately, such as addresses and shipping methods.

ListEcommerceCartShippingsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation to fetch shipping information for the cart.
